currencyNotes: BRL for Brazil (fiscalYear 2025 = calendar 2025), EUR for Deloitte Money League (fiscalYear 2025 = season 2024/25). Sources disagree for some Brazilian clubs (e.g. Palmeiras 2025 revenue 1.605bn Convocados / 1.696bn Sports Value / ~1.78bn other); Sports Value used for consistency. totalDebt is Anresf end-2025 aggregate (includes tax/labour debt), not directly comparable to EY net debt. No audited statements read directly. 'division' is an added field; Série A/B = 2026 membership.
